sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: At a campaign rally in Georgia late last month,
sentences.zh: 在上个月下旬佐治亚州的一场竞选集会上，

sentences.en: Vice President Kamala Harris spoke to supporters about one of the biggest issues in this election, immigration.
sentences.zh: 副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯向支持者谈到了这次选举中最大的问题之一：移民。

sentences.en: She talked up her record as the former attorney general of a border state.
sentences.zh: 她大谈自己作为边境州前总检察长的政绩。

sentences.en: And she made a promise.
sentences.zh: 并且她做出了一个承诺。

sentences.en: As president, I will bring back the border security bill that Donald Trump killed.
sentences.zh: 作为总统，我将重新提出唐纳德·特朗普扼杀的边境安全法案。

sentences.en: And I will sign it, it looks like.
sentences.zh: 而且看来我会签署它。

sentences.en: That bill she was talking about was negotiated starting late last year by a bipartisan trio of senators.
sentences.zh: 她谈到的那项法案是自去年底开始由一个跨党派参议员三人组谈判达成的。

sentences.en: The Republican in that group was Senator James Lankford, a former Baptist youth minister from Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 该组织中的共和党人是参议员詹姆斯·兰克福德，他是俄克拉荷马州的前浸信会青年牧师。

sentences.en: Lankford clearly has big ambitions in the party.
sentences.zh: 兰克福德在党内显然有着宏大的雄心。

sentences.en: He's currently running for Senate leadership.
sentences.zh: 他目前正在竞选参议院领导层。

sentences.en: And for months, he worked on that immigration bill with Kyrsten Sinema, the Independent from Arizona, and Chris Murphy, the Democrat from Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，他与来自亚利桑那州的无党派人士基尔斯滕·西内马以及来自康涅狄格州的民主党人克里斯·墨菲共同致力于该移民法案。

sentences.en: It was a rare show of bipartisanship.
sentences.zh: 这是一种罕见的跨党派合作表现。

sentences.en: And after sign-off from both Senate party leaders and an endorsement from the White House, the bill looked like it was going to become law.
sentences.zh: 在获得双方参议院党团领导人的签字认可以及白宫的背书后，该法案看起来即将成为法律。

sentences.en: It would have been the first major piece of bipartisan legislation on immigration in decades.
sentences.zh: 这本该是几十年来第一部关于移民的主要跨党派立法。

sentences.en: But then Donald Trump came out against it, saying he didn't want to give Democrats a political win on such a sensitive issue during an election year.
sentences.zh: 但随后唐纳德·特朗普站出来反对，称他不想在选举年让民主党在这样一个敏感问题上获得政治胜利。

sentences.en: And even though the bill contained most of the hardline policies the right had wanted, it became toxic in the GOP.
sentences.zh: 尽管该法案包含了右翼一直想要的绝大部分强硬政策，但它在共和党内变成了毒药。

sentences.en: In the end, only four Republican senators voted for it.
sentences.zh: 最终，只有四名共和党参议员投票赞成。

sentences.en: The bill tanked, and Lankford was left holding the bag.
sentences.zh: 该法案彻底失败，兰克福德成了背锅侠。

sentences.en: I've covered the immigration system since the beginning of my career.
sentences.zh: 我从职业生涯之初就开始报道移民系统。

sentences.en: So I really wanted to talk to Lankford about his experience working so hard on this bill, only to see it fall apart.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很想和兰克福德聊聊他为这项法案付出巨大努力却眼睁睁看着它破裂的经历。

sentences.en: And what that failed attempt at bipartisanship shows about the possibility of getting anything done by a Republican Party that is so beholden to Trump.
sentences.zh: 以及这次失败的跨党派尝试表明了，面对如此依附于特朗普的共和党，把事情办成的可能性究竟有多大。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Senator James Lankford.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与参议员詹姆斯·兰克福德的对话。

sentences.en: Senator Lankford, before you were in politics, you ran the largest Baptist youth camp in the country, Falls Creek.
sentences.zh: 兰克福德参议员，在从政之前，你曾管理过全国最大的浸信会青年营地——福尔斯克里克。

sentences.en: You know, a friend of mine from Oklahoma basically said it's the place everyone goes when they're young.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我在俄克拉荷马州的一个朋友基本上说那是每个人年轻时都会去的地方。

sentences.en: I think when you were elected, something like 40 percent of Republican primary voters in Oklahoma either went to Falls Creek or knew someone who did.
sentences.zh: 我想在你当选时，俄克拉荷马州大约百分之四十的共和党初选选民去过福尔斯克里克或者认识去过的人。

sentences.en: What role did that organization play in your life?
sentences.zh: 那个组织在你的生命中扮演了什么角色？

sentences.en: Wow, that's a huge question.
sentences.zh: 哇，这是一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: Let's spend about six hours talking this through to be able to catch up on it real quick.
sentences.zh: 让我们花大约六个小时来探讨这个问题，以便快速赶上进度。

sentences.en: I would say a couple of things.
sentences.zh: 我想说几点。

sentences.en: One is I served 22 years in ministry working with students in those families.
sentences.zh: 第一是我在服事中度过了22年，与学生和这些家庭一起工作。

sentences.en: So when you work with middle school and high school students, you're engaging in ministry and life and you're dealing with all kinds of trauma that happens in those families.
sentences.zh: 所以当你和初中生及高中生一起工作时，你是在参与服事和生活，并在处理这些家庭中发生的各种创伤。

sentences.en: That's what I did and what my wife and I did for 22 years to be able to just love on families and to encourage them.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所做的，也是我和我妻子22年来一直在做的事，为了去爱护家庭并鼓励他们。

sentences.en: I didn't do anything in politics other than vote.
sentences.zh: 除了投票，我没有参与任何政治活动。

sentences.en: And in 2008 and 2009, we really felt a calling to be able to run for Congress in the Central District.
sentences.zh: 在2008年和2009年，我们确实感受到了号召，决定去竞选中部选区的国会议员。

sentences.en: And I had to go to our state Republican leaders and introduce myself and say, hi, my name's James.
sentences.zh: 我不得不去找我们州的共和党领袖并做自我介绍，说，嗨，我叫詹姆斯。

sentences.en: I'm filing to run for Congress.
sentences.zh: 我正在登记竞选国会议员。

sentences.en: And they basically pat me on the head and said, that's nice.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上拍拍我的头说，这很好。

sentences.en: Most of my friends said, is this a joke?
sentences.zh: 我的大多数朋友都说，这是个笑话吗？

sentences.en: And I would just say, it's actually not.
sentences.zh: 而我会说，其实真不是。

sentences.en: This is something I feel strongly to be able to do.
sentences.zh: 这是我强烈感觉到必须去做的一件事。

sentences.en: But saying all that, my faith is important to me and it's not something I take off and put on.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我的信仰对我很重要，它不是那种随穿随脱的东西。

sentences.en: I tell people all the time, your faith should affect everything about you.
sentences.zh: 我总是告诉人们，你的信仰应该影响关于你的一切。

sentences.en: It's how I treat my wife.
sentences.zh: 这是我对待我妻子的方式。

sentences.en: It's how I treat total strangers.
sentences.zh: 这是我对待完全陌生人的方式。

sentences.en: It's how I drive.
sentences.zh: 这是我开车的方式。

sentences.en: It's how I interact with my staff.
sentences.zh: 这是我与员工互动的方式。

sentences.en: It's how I take on issues.
sentences.zh: 这是我处理问题的方式。

sentences.en: I believe every person's created in the image of God.
sentences.zh: 我相信每个人都是按照神的形象创造的。

sentences.en: They have value and worth.
sentences.zh: 他们具有价值和尊严。

sentences.en: Even if I disagree with them, that person has value and worth.
sentences.zh: 即使我不同意他们的观点，这个人也具有价值和尊严。

sentences.en: And so my faith affects how I see people and how I interact on areas of disagreement because I see them as people that we may disagree with.
sentences.zh: 因此，我的信仰影响了我如何看待人们以及如何在存在分歧的领域进行互动，因为我把他们看作我们可能意见不一的人。

sentences.en: And as I joke with some of my Democrat colleagues, we're friends, but they're wrong all the time.
sentences.zh: 正如我和我的一些民主党同事开玩笑的那样，我们是朋友，但他们总是错的。

sentences.en: They just vote wrong all the time.
sentences.zh: 他们投票总是投错。

sentences.en: But we can still be friends in our conversation and relationship and try to be able to engage in that idea.
sentences.zh: 但我们在对话和关系中仍然可以成为朋友，并尝试参与到这种理念中去。

sentences.en: That's something deeply held in my own personal faith because of what I've been forgiven of and what I've seen God do in my own life.
sentences.zh: 由于我所蒙受的宽恕以及我看到上帝在我生命中所做的事，这是我个人信仰中深信不疑的事情。

sentences.en: Why wouldn't I allow other people the mercy and grace to have that happen in their own life as well?
sentences.zh: 我为什么不给其他人同样的仁慈和恩典，让他们自己的生命中也发生这种事呢？

sentences.en: So you arrived in the House as part of the Tea Party movement in 2011.
sentences.zh: 所以你作为2011年茶党运动的一部分进入了众议院。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Then you were elected to the Senate in 2014.
sentences.zh: 然后你在2014年当选参议员。

sentences.en: I remember that you worked with Kamala Harris, the vice president, quite closely in the Senate in 2017 when you crafted an election security bill
sentences.zh: 我记得在2017年参议院制定关于俄罗斯选举干预的选举安全法案时，你与副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯进行了相当紧密的合作

sentences.en: around Russian election interference.
sentences.zh: 围绕着俄罗斯的选举干预。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What was that work like and what was your relationship with her like back then?
sentences.zh: 那项工作是怎样的，你当时和她的关系怎么样？

sentences.en: She was a brand new senator coming in in 2017.
sentences.zh: 她是在2017年刚上任的全新参议员。

sentences.en: We actually traveled to Afghanistan together.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上一起去了阿富汗旅行。

sentences.en: And so we did have the opportunity to be able to spend some time.
sentences.zh: 所以我们确实有机会度过了一些时间。

sentences.en: Obviously, we have wide policy disagreements on things, but we were able to sit down and to be able to talk frankly, to be able to work through things
sentences.zh: 很明显，我们在事情上有广泛的政策分歧，但我们能够坐下来坦诚地交谈，共同解决问题

sentences.en: and always had a cordial conversation where I could say this is my boundaries of where I think we need to work on.
sentences.zh: 并且总是有着亲切的对话，我可以表达我需要开展工作的界限在哪里。

sentences.en: And she would say the same and we'd figure out how to be able to hit some common ground on it.
sentences.zh: 她也会这样说，然后我们找出如何在其中达成一些共识。

sentences.en: Obviously, that was challenging for us and for her.
sentences.zh: 显然，这对我们和她来说都充满挑战。

sentences.en: She's very progressive.
sentences.zh: 她非常进步。

sentences.en: I'm very conservative.
sentences.zh: 我非常保守。

sentences.en: When I talk to people in Oklahoma, they'll say I couldn't work with the people that you work with.
sentences.zh: 当我与俄克拉荷马州的人交谈时，他们会说我无法和那些你共事的人一起工作。

sentences.en: They would drive me crazy.
sentences.zh: 他们会把我逼疯的。

sentences.en: I see them on TV and I just can't believe some of the things they say and always remind people, I don't pick the people I work with.
sentences.zh: 我在电视上看到他们，简直无法相信他们说的一些话，我总是提醒人们，我挑选不了和我共事的人。

sentences.en: Other people pick the people I work with.
sentences.zh: 其他人挑选和我共事的人。

sentences.en: I just have to work with them.
sentences.zh: 我只需要和他们一起工作。

sentences.en: And we've got to be able to figure out how to do this because there's more to get done.
sentences.zh: 我们必须弄清楚该怎么做，因为还有更多事情需要完成。

sentences.en: Speaking of working across the aisle, I want to talk to you about immigration, which is one of the top issues of this election.
sentences.zh: 说到跨党派合作，我想和你谈谈移民问题，这是本次选举中最重大的问题之一。

sentences.en: Why would you talk to me about immigration?
sentences.zh: 你为什么会跟我谈移民问题？

sentences.en: What would I know about it?
sentences.zh: 我对它能知道什么？

sentences.en: At the end of last year, you raised your national profile when you were tapped by Mitch McConnell to negotiate a bipartisan border bill.
sentences.zh: 去年底，当您被米奇·麦康奈尔选中去谈判一项跨党派边境法案时，您的全国知名度上升了。

sentences.en: You worked for four months with Kyrsten Sinema, the independent senator from Arizona, and Chris Murphy, the Democrat from Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 你与来自亚利桑那州的无党派参议员基尔斯滕·西内马和来自康涅狄格州的民主党人克里斯·墨菲合作了四个月。

sentences.en: Can you tell me a bit about how you all moved through that process?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我讲讲你们是如何经历那个过程的吗？

sentences.en: So Kyrsten Sinema is an immigration attorney in her past, and so she's extremely knowledgeable about this.
sentences.zh: 所以基尔斯滕·西内马过去是一名移民律师，因此她对此极其了解。

sentences.en: Obviously, Arizona is one of the epicenters of illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 显然，亚利桑那州是非法移民的重灾区之一。

sentences.en: And so she was very engaged, very knowledgeable of the issues.
sentences.zh: 所以她非常投入，对这些问题非常了解。

sentences.en: And every time we talked about it, she could give a personal story of this is what it actually looks like on the ground.
sentences.zh: 每次我们谈到它，她都能讲一个个人故事，说这在实地实际上是什么样子的。

sentences.en: This is why this is important to be able to resolve.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么解决这个问题很重要的原因。

sentences.en: And again, she grew up in Southern Arizona, so she grew up with people crossing the border.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，她在南亚利桑那州长大，所以她是在人们越过边境的环境中长大的。

sentences.en: But she could also say how different this is now than what it was 20 years ago, 30 years ago, who's coming, where they're coming from, and the threats that are there.
sentences.zh: 但她也能说出现在的状况与20年前、30年前有何不同，谁在来，他们从哪里来，以及那里存在的威胁。

sentences.en: So working with Kyrsten was a lot of conversation about practical things, trying to be able to give context to it.
sentences.zh: 所以和基尔斯滕合作有很多关于实际事情的对话，试图为其提供背景。

sentences.en: Senator Murphy, he's a progressive from Connecticut, extremely smart, but it's a different perspective when you're from New England on dealing with immigration.
sentences.zh: 墨菲参议员，他是来自康涅狄格州的进步派，极其聪明，但当你来自新英格兰时，处理移民问题的视角是不同的。

sentences.en: He was keenly aware of the criminal aspects of some folks that are coming across that are real threats to national security.
sentences.zh: 他敏锐地意识到一些过境人员的犯罪方面，这对国家安全构成了真正的威胁。

sentences.en: He wanted to be able to focus in on those aspects, but he was also very outspoken the whole time that he's very supportive of the dreamers, and he wanted to be able to resolve
sentences.zh: 他希望专注于这些方面，但他也一直直言不讳地表示他非常支持追梦人，并且他希望能够解决

sentences.en: a lot of bigger issues that have been there, which we weren't going to be able to make any progress on at this point.
sentences.zh: 许多长期存在的大问题，而我们在这一点上将无法取得任何进展。

sentences.en: And so there was a lot of dialogue back and forth about how do we actually find the areas of agreement that we can on the national security issues
sentences.zh: 因此，关于我们如何在国家安全问题上真正找到我们可以达成一致的领域，进行了很多来回的对话

sentences.en: and not continue to make this so big that it falls under its own weight.
sentences.zh: 而不是让这件事变得太大以至于在自身的重压下垮掉。

sentences.en: Ultimately, at the end of the day, we weren't able to find a bill that was actually, I could get enough Republicans on board on to be able to move on it,
sentences.zh: 归根结底，我们没能找到一项法案，实际上，我能争取到足够的共和党人支持以推动它，

sentences.en: but he was very successful moving Democrats to be able to say, let's work on national security, we'll come back and work on other areas later.
sentences.zh: 但他成功地让民主党人表示，让我们致力于国家安全，其他领域我们以后再回来处理。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You know, this was a very tough border bill.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一项非常严厉的边境法案。

sentences.en: There was no legal pathway to citizenship, for example, as you mentioned, for dreamers.
sentences.zh: 例如，正如你所提到的，没有针对追梦人的合法入籍途径。

sentences.en: Why wasn't that included?
sentences.zh: 为什么没有包含那个？

sentences.en: Did you think it was going to be basically a bill killer for the Republican side of things?
sentences.zh: 你认为这基本上会成为共和党阵营中法案的终结者吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Quite frankly, I did believe that would be a bill killer, that it would not move through the House or through the Senate if that was included.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，我确实相信那将是法案的终结者，如果包含这一点，它将无法在众议院或参议院通过。

sentences.en: When you have two and a half million people a year that are crossing the border illegally, when you've got millions of people in the backlog,
sentences.zh: 当每年有二百五十万人非法越境，当你有数百万积压案件时，

sentences.en: the energy and the focus was, let's first stop the bleeding, and then let's figure out how to be able to take care of everything else.
sentences.zh: 精力和重点是，让我们首先止血，然后再想办法处理其他一切。

sentences.en: There will be moments to be able to deal with DACA and other issues.
sentences.zh: 总会有时刻来处理DACA和其他问题。

sentences.en: It's not like that's not going to come up, but we've got to figure out a way to be able to make this stop right now.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说那不会被提出，但我们必须找出一种方法，让这种情况现在就停下来。

sentences.en: And you felt the Democrats understood that.
sentences.zh: 你觉得民主党人理解这一点。

sentences.en: Eventually.
sentences.zh: 最终理解了。

sentences.en: And the administration understood that.
sentences.zh: 政府也理解了这一点。

sentences.en: Eventually.
sentences.zh: 最终理解了。

sentences.en: That was a long conversation.
sentences.zh: 那是一场漫长的对话。

sentences.en: I would tell you that was one of the most contentious areas of the debate all along that Chris Murphy never let go of.
sentences.zh: 我会告诉你，那是克里斯·墨菲从未放弃的辩论中最具争议的领域之一。

sentences.en: He was very faithful to his perspective on that one to say this is really important.
sentences.zh: 他在那一观点上非常忠于自己的立场，说这真的很重要。

sentences.en: And I hear him that it's really important, but I also understood there was absolutely no way he would have a chance with the number of people that we're dealing with right now
sentences.zh: 我听到他说这真的很重要，但我也明白，以我们目前正在处理的非法越境进入国家的人数来看，绝对没有机会

sentences.en: that are illegally crossing in the country that the overwhelming sense is, and I hear from Republicans and Democrats alike in my state in Oklahoma, how does this stop?
sentences.zh: 压倒性的看法是——我在我的家乡俄克拉荷马州听到了共和党人和民主党人的一致看法——这怎么能停止？

sentences.en: How does this get better?
sentences.zh: 这怎么能变得更好？

sentences.en: You seem to have won every concession from Democrats that Republicans wanted.
sentences.zh: 你似乎赢得了民主党人想要的所有共和党人想要的妥协。

sentences.en: And I'm curious now, in hindsight,
sentences.zh: 我现在很好奇，事后看来，

sentences.en: why you think that's true.
sentences.zh: 你认为为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Do you think Democrats and the Biden administration in particular realized that they had a problem on their hands at the southern border?
sentences.zh: 你认为民主党人，特别是拜登政府，是否意识到他们手头在南部边境遇到了一个问题？

sentences.en: So, yes.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: I believe that the administration came to the table because they understood this is spiraling out of control.
sentences.zh: 我相信政府来到谈判桌前是因为他们明白这正在失控。

sentences.en: And quite frankly, I think they perceived they could say, okay, those crazy Republicans, they forced us to be able to pass this bill, so we're going to implement this
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，我认为他们觉得可以说，好吧，那些疯狂的共和党人，他们强迫我们通过这项法案，所以我们要实施这个

sentences.en: when they actually quietly wanted to say, okay, we got to make this stop.
sentences.zh: 而他们实际上私下里想说的是，好吧，我们得让这停下来。

sentences.en: What can be done to be able to get control of the border?
sentences.zh: 为了重新控制边境，能做些什么？

sentences.en: Before we get to what ended up happening, while you were working on this, were you optimistic
sentences.zh: 在我们谈到最终发生的事情之前，当你在做这件事的时候，你是否乐观

sentences.en: that it could succeed?
sentences.zh: 认为它能成功？

sentences.en: I was.
sentences.zh: 我是乐观的。

sentences.en: I was.
sentences.zh: 我是乐观的。

sentences.en: It needed to.
sentences.zh: 确实需要如此。

sentences.en: And the comments that all three of us made was, we have to keep working even when it got really hard and we wanted to walk away from the table.
sentences.zh: 我们三个人共同的看法是，即使情况变得非常艰难、我们很想一走了之，我们也必须继续工作。

sentences.en: We didn't walk away from the table even when we looked like we were in an impasse because we had to get something done.
sentences.zh: 即使看起来我们陷入了僵局，我们也没有一走了之，因为我们必须把事情办成。

sentences.en: And all signs indicated that your optimism was actually founded and that the bill was going to pass until Trump came out forcefully against it.
sentences.zh: 所有的迹象都表明，你的乐观是有根据的，法案本来会通过的，直到特朗普公开强烈反对它。

sentences.en: I mean, he was basically whipping against it from Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他基本上是在海湖庄园煽动大家反对它。

sentences.en: Did he call you personally?
sentences.zh: 他亲自给你打电话了吗？

sentences.en: And if so, what did he say?
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，他说什么了？

sentences.en: We did not talk during that time period, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在那段时间我们没有交谈。

sentences.en: On my part, that was intentional, quite frankly, because of that exact question.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，坦率地说，那是刻意为之的，正是因为那个具体的问题。

sentences.en: I didn't want this to be perceived as a, this is President Trump actually trying to be able to run this bill.
sentences.zh: 我不希望这被视为特朗普总统在实际试图主导这项法案。

sentences.en: That would be toxic to my Democrat colleagues and this needed to be something that we do as a party to be able to resolve right now.
sentences.zh: 这对我的民主党同僚来说将是有毒的，这需要是我们作为一个党派现在就能解决的事情。

sentences.en: I honestly believe that exact bill would have passed in December, but by the time it got into February and we were in the heart of the presidential primary election,
sentences.zh: 我真心相信，同样的法案如果在十二月就会通过，但到了二月，当我们处于总统初选的核心阶段时，

sentences.en: it became immediately the major focus in the election because the Republican primary suddenly got resolved.
sentences.zh: 它立即成为了选举中的主要焦点，因为共和党初选突然有了结果。

sentences.en: It looked very obvious that President Trump was going to be there and everything collapsed at that point.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统将要参加竞选这件事变得非常明显，从那一刻起，一切都崩溃了。

sentences.en: If that bill would have gone in December, I think it would have passed.
sentences.zh: 如果那个法案在十二月通过，我认为它本可以通过。

sentences.en: I mean, you've said before that a right-wing commentator threatened you over this bill.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你以前说过，一名右翼评论员曾因为这项法案威胁过你。

sentences.en: Radio host Jesse Kelly took credit.
sentences.zh: 电台主持人杰西·凯利承认了此事。

sentences.en: Was it him?
sentences.zh: 是他吗？

sentences.en: I would only say when he took credit for that, my first response was, who is that?
sentences.zh: 我只想说，当他承认这一点时，我的第一反应是：那是谁？

sentences.en: So, no, it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 所以，不是他。

sentences.en: I would only say, and I've never identified who it is and I won't, but I did have several folks, one just more blunt than others, saying,
sentences.zh: 我只想说——我从未透露过他是谁，我也不会透露——但确实有几个人，其中一个比其他人更直言不讳，他们说：

sentences.en: I'll destroy you if you do this because though I like you, I like President Trump better and he's got to be elected for the future of the country and you can't take this issue
sentences.zh: 如果你这么做，我会毁了你，因为虽然我喜欢你，但我更喜欢特朗普总统，为了国家的未来，他必须当选，你不能把这个议题

sentences.en: off the table.
sentences.zh: 搁置。

sentences.en: My response was, he has a job that's running for office right now, but I'm in office.
sentences.zh: 我的回应是：他现在的工作是竞选公职，而我正在任职。

sentences.en: I've got to do my job.
sentences.zh: 我必须做好我的工作。

sentences.en: My job is national security.
sentences.zh: 我的工作是国家安全。

sentences.en: I serve on the Intelligence Committee.
sentences.zh: 我在情报委员会任职。

sentences.en: I serve on Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 我在国土安全委员会任职。

sentences.en: I have access to a lot of classified information.
sentences.zh: 我能接触到大量机密信息。

sentences.en: Starting the last year, we saw the shift that happened on who was crossing the border.
sentences.zh: 从去年开始，我们看到过境人群发生了转变。

sentences.en: It was more and more people from outside the Western Hemisphere.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的人来自西半球以外。

sentences.en: It was a very different group that was coming across and it was criminal organizations that were becoming travel agents to be able to move people and then they were moving people
sentences.zh: 跨越边境的是一个截然不同的群体，犯罪组织变成了旅行社来运送人员，然后他们运送

sentences.en: that wanted to be able to work here and then facilitating people that were within their organization.
sentences.zh: 那些想在这里工作的人，并为他们组织内部的人提供便利。

sentences.en: That's why we had a couple of months ago eight folks that were picked up in the United States that were ISIS-affiliated.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么几个月前我们在美国抓获了八名与ISIS有关联的人。

sentences.en: They were moving through those networks that I was aware of before and what was one of the many reasons I was so passionate to say we can't ignore this moment.
sentences.zh: 他们正通过我之前了解的那些网络移动，这也是我如此充满激情地表示我们不能忽视这一时刻的众多原因之一。

sentences.en: We see the national security threats that we're facing.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了我们面临的国家安全威胁。

sentences.en: We cannot allow people into our country through these illegal networks that can come in and request asylum that we can't tell the difference at the border between those who mean
sentences.zh: 我们不能允许人们通过这些非法网络进入我国并申请庇护，我们在边境无法区分那些意图

sentences.en: to do us harm and those who are coming to reconnect with family.
sentences.zh: 对我们造成伤害的人和那些前来与家人团聚的人。

sentences.en: We cannot tell the difference.
sentences.zh: 我们无法区分。

sentences.en: The frustration that I have is that it's become more of a political issue than a national security issue when it is really a national security issue.
sentences.zh: 让我感到沮丧的是，它更多地变成了一个政治问题，而不是一个国家安全问题，而它实际上是一个国家安全问题。

sentences.en: When did you get a sense that this was not going to happen?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候预感到这不会成功的？

sentences.en: There were always people that are opposed to it.
sentences.zh: 总是有人反对它。

sentences.en: We knew from the beginning this is hard.
sentences.zh: 我们从一开始就知道这很困难。

sentences.en: There's a reason this hasn't been done in decades.
sentences.zh: 几十年来一直没有完成这件事是有原因的。

sentences.en: There were political commentators on television that came out immediately and online saying that we can't solve the border issue right now.
sentences.zh: 电视和网络上的政治评论员立即跳出来说，我们现在无法解决边境问题。

sentences.en: This is the single biggest issue.
sentences.zh: 这是最重大的单一问题。

sentences.en: We don't want President Trump
sentences.zh: 我们不希望特朗普总统

sentences.en: to lose that issue.
sentences.zh: 失去这个议题。

sentences.en: Or they would say
sentences.zh: 或者他们会说：

sentences.en: President Biden created this chaos.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统造成了这场混乱。

sentences.en: We don't want to give him the appearance right before the election that he then solved the crisis that he created.
sentences.zh: 我们不想在选举前夕给他留下这样的印象：他随后解决了自己造成的危机。

sentences.en: And I would tell you not just as a conservative, as an American, this is a crisis that the administration did botch.
sentences.zh: 我要告诉你，不仅作为一名保守派，作为一个美国人，这是该届政府确实搞砸的一场危机。

sentences.en: For President Biden and Vice President Harris, who talked a lot about immigration in the earliest days, I said to their team over and over and over again, if you would enforce
sentences.zh: 对于拜登总统和哈里斯副总统来说，他们在早期谈了很多关于移民的事情，我一次又一次地对他们的团队说，如果你能像

sentences.en: the border the same way
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统那样

sentences.en: President Obama did,
sentences.zh: 执行边境政策，

sentences.en: I know you don't want to do it the same way
sentences.zh: 我知道你不想像

sentences.en: President Trump did, but if you do it the same way
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统那样做，但如果你采取和

sentences.en: President Obama did, we would not have this problem that we have today.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统一样的方式，我们就不会有今天的问题。

sentences.en: Under President Obama, we had half a million people illegally crossing a year.
sentences.zh: 在奥巴马总统任内，我们每年有五十万人非法越境。

sentences.en: Now we have two and a half million people illegally crossing.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有两百五十万人非法越境。

sentences.en: So I would bring all those things up to be able to talk about it on both sides, understanding it's going to be hard, but then just the noise continued to build.
sentences.zh: 所以我提出了所有这些事情，以便在双方进行讨论，理解这会很困难，但随后杂音继续增加。

sentences.en: And we reached a fever there in that first week of February.
sentences.zh: 我们在二月的第一周达到了狂热的顶峰。

sentences.en: I think within the last 48 hours, I really realized this is not going to work.
sentences.zh: 我想在过去48小时内，我真正意识到这行不通了。

sentences.en: This is not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这不会发生了。

sentences.en: And indeed, you were unable to persuade your party.
sentences.zh: 的确，你没能说服你的党派。

sentences.en: And what happened next is truly crazy.
sentences.zh: 接下来发生的事情简直疯狂。

sentences.en: Can you tell me what it was like to vote against your own bill that you'd worked so hard on?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我，投票反对你为之付出如此努力的自己的法案，是什么感觉吗？

sentences.en: I voted for my bill when it came to the floor and it was an actual vote.
sentences.zh: 当我的法案提交到参议院全院并且是一次真正的投票时，我投了赞成票。

sentences.en: Now, two months later,
sentences.zh: 现在，两个月后，

sentences.en: Senator Schumer brought it back up as a political exercise to try to poke
sentences.zh: 舒默参议员把它重新提出来，作为一种试图惹恼

sentences.en: Republicans in the eye.
sentences.zh: 共和党人的政治操弄。

sentences.en: And I said, no, this was never designed to be a political exercise of what I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 我说不，我所做的事从来就不是为了搞政治操弄。

sentences.en: And so at that point, I vote against it.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个时候，我投了反对票。

sentences.en: Kyrsten Sinema voted against it.
sentences.zh: 基尔斯滕·西内马投了反对票。

sentences.en: But when it was an actual live round, I was eager to come to the floor and say, it's not everything I would want, but it's also not nothing.
sentences.zh: 但当这是一场真正的实质性表决时，我急于来到参议院全院表示：它不是我想要的一切，但它也不是什么都没有。

sentences.en: It does make progress.
sentences.zh: 它确实取得了进展。

sentences.en: We should make progress in areas where we can make progress and then come back and do more.
sentences.zh: 我们应该在能够取得进展的领域取得进展，然后再回来做更多的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, you've talked about this as a national security issue, but I am curious about how the work on immigration connects to your faith because there is this philosophy
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你一直把这当作一个国家安全问题来谈论，但我很好奇，移民方面的工作如何与你的信仰联系起来，因为在福音派世界里存在着这样一种哲学，

sentences.en: in the evangelical world and it's based in scripture around the idea of welcoming the stranger.
sentences.zh: 它基于关于接纳陌生人这一概念的经文。

sentences.en: And the National Association of Evangelicals did support your bill.
sentences.zh: 全美福音派协会确实支持了你的法案。

sentences.en: I'm curious if you think that there is some daylight between the MAGA wing of the party and evangelical groups on this issue.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道，你是否认为党内的MAGA派与福音派团体在这个问题上存在一些分歧。

sentences.en: Yes, there is actually.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实有。

sentences.en: I think there's just an energy that people have to say, I want people to still be welcome in America.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们内心有一种能量，想要表达：我仍然希望人们受到美国的欢迎。

sentences.en: There are people that are asylees that are fleeing from injustice around the world.
sentences.zh: 有些人是逃离世界各地不公正待遇的避难者。

sentences.en: We don't want to ever lose in America that we're not a place for that.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不希望美国失去这样一个地方的特质。

sentences.en: But we also know that right now we have two and a half million people a year that are legally crossing.
sentences.zh: 但我们也知道，现在我们每年有两百五十万人合法越境。

sentences.en: We also don't want that
sentences.zh: 我们也不希望那样，

sentences.en: because when you create that kind of chaos, that's not just a faith issue to say we're going to welcome the stranger.
sentences.zh: 因为当你造成那种混乱时，这不仅仅是一个关于我们要接纳陌生人的信仰问题。

sentences.en: That's also welcoming folks that are, again, not just pursuing a job and pursuing family, which is the vast majority of people that are coming, but it's also welcoming
sentences.zh: 这也是在欢迎那些——再说一次，不仅仅是追求工作和追求家庭的人，这是绝大多数来这里的人——但它也是在欢迎

sentences.en: in people that are coming right now that are from
sentences.zh: 那些目前正从

sentences.en: Venezuelan gangs that are crossing in, requesting asylum, and then they're
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉帮派越境并申请庇护的人，然后他们

sentences.en: deliberately targeting
sentences.zh: 蓄意把目标对准

sentences.en: Venezuelans that are here in America right now and then abusing them the same way they did back in Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 目前身处美国的委内瑞拉人，并以他们在委内瑞拉时受到过的方式虐待他们。

sentences.en: That's also occurring right now.
sentences.zh: 这现在也正在发生。

sentences.en: And we do have human trafficking and we can all say, well, that's not the majority, but there is human trafficking, there is violence, there is sex trafficking, all these things
sentences.zh: 我们确实有人口贩运，我们都可以说，这并非多数，但确实有人口贩运、暴力、性贩运，所有这些事情

sentences.en: are also occurring as well and it occurs because we have too many people to manage on a day-to-day basis at the border.
sentences.zh: 也都在发生，之所以发生，是因为我们在边境日常需要管理的人太多了。

sentences.en: I mean, speaking of the range of opinion in the GOP on this issue, there were signs at the RNC saying mass deportation now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，说到共和党在这个问题上的意见范围，RNC（共和党全国代表大会）上有标语写着“立即大规模驱逐”。

sentences.en: I mean, that is one of the tenets of the Trump platform.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是特朗普政治纲领的信条之一。

sentences.en: Is that a position that you think is the right one?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是一个正确的立场吗？

sentences.en: So, yeah, by the way, I think there will be mass deportations at some point and people define that differently and they hear that.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，顺便说一句，我认为在某个时候会有大规模驱逐，人们对它的定义各有不同，他们的理解也不同。

sentences.en: Some people hear that as a Latina grandmother that's been here
sentences.zh: 有些人听到这个词，会想到一个在这里待了

sentences.en: 30 years and they're going to say, is she also the target?
sentences.zh: 30年的拉丁裔祖母，他们会问，她也是目标吗？

sentences.en: I think the first target that ends up coming are the folks that literally a court and we have millions of people now that a court has ruled on a final order of removal and no one's
sentences.zh: 我认为最终成为第一批目标的，是那些字面意义上经法院裁决——我们现在有数百万人，法院已对其下达了最终驱逐令，但没有人

sentences.en: actually removing them.
sentences.zh: 真正去驱逐他们——的人。

sentences.en: And I think that's where a lot of Americans are really frustrated to say, hold on, now we have people that are crossing,
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是许多美国人感到真正沮丧的地方，他们会说：等等，现在我们有人在越境，

sentences.en: that are crossing illegally, that are going through the process, they're requesting asylum, that they know they don't qualify for, they finally get to the end of it
sentences.zh: 非法越境，经历这个程序，申请庇护，而他们明知自己不符合资格，他们终于走到了程序的尽头，

sentences.en: and they find out, no, you don't qualify.
sentences.zh: 却发现：不，你不符合资格。

sentences.en: But Senator Lankford, you know that a lot of people understand mass deportations as the rounding up of perhaps a Latina grandmother that's been here for a long time, communities
sentences.zh: 但是，兰克福德参议员，你知道许多人将大规模驱逐理解为搜捕可能在这里呆了很长时间的拉丁裔祖母、

sentences.en: that have settled and have been here for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 已经定居并在这里生活了很多很多年的社区。

sentences.en: And many supporters of your party do want there to be just a complete uprooting of people who are undocumented.
sentences.zh: 你党内的许多支持者确实希望彻底根除无证移民。

sentences.en: Yeah, I actually don't see a future Trump administration just rounding up all 12 million,
sentences.zh: 是的，我其实并不认为未来的特朗普政府会把所有1200万、

sentences.en: 15 million, whatever number that is and removing the entire number.
sentences.zh: 1500万或其他任何数字的人全部搜捕起来并将他们全部驱逐出境。

sentences.en: I just don't.
sentences.zh: 我只是不这么认为。

sentences.en: I see them targeting the folks that are, have gone through the court proceedings, that have been ruled that they're not legally present, have a criminal record.

sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我认为不会出现把1500万人集中搜捕并关进集中营然后运走的情况，因为那不符合

sentences.zh: 我只是想知道，对于同僚们不想立法这件事，你有什么感悟？

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，政治在这里战胜了政策，这对你说明了什么？

sentences.zh: 政治战胜了政策。

sentences.en: No doubt on that.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.zh: 我有同僚说，嘿，这非常专业，我需要一周时间来阅读和审阅，然后才能对此投票。

sentences.en: And I said, I totally understand that.
sentences.zh: 我说，我完全理解这一点。

sentences.en: We'll give you the time to do that.
sentences.zh: 我们会给你时间去做的。

sentences.en: But within 30 minutes of the bill being released, they were putting out statements saying,
sentences.zh: 但在法案公布后30分钟内，他们就发表声明称：

sentences.en: I'm opposed to it.
sentences.zh: 我反对它。

sentences.en: It's terrible.
sentences.zh: 这太糟糕了。

sentences.en: So a couple of things I would say on that.
sentences.zh: 所以关于这一点，我有几点看法。

sentences.en: One is we needed more cooks in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 第一，我们需要更多参与其中、出谋划策的人。

sentences.en: this controversial.
sentences.zh: 且如此具争议的问题的过程，

sentences.zh: 我们需要更多真正投入其中并在早期就深度参与的人。

sentences.en: I tried to keep my conference as informed as I could without it all leaking out to the media where we were because for Chris Murphy and Kirsten Sinema and I, we were very committed

sentences.en: But we needed more people that were personally invested and I think that was a mistake of the negotiation.

sentences.en: It would be great if our committees worked and actually pushed out a lot of very hard things like this, but they've not been successful of late of actually getting negotiations

sentences.en: and getting commitment on that.

sentences.en: I hope that we can get back to that.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们能回到那样的状态。

sentences.zh: 我们确实有一些像FAA（联邦航空局）法案这样的大型法案，最终达成了一致同意的决议，推进并通过了。

sentences.zh: 很显然，

sentences.zh: 但有一堆问题比其他问题更棘手。

sentences.zh: 对党内事务的态度有多少独立性？

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你们是独立于政府的另一个分支。

sentences.zh: 是的，我们是。

sentences.zh: 正如我跟人们开玩笑时所说的那样，但这是千真万确的。

sentences.zh: 有些人会告诉我，当特朗普总统在任时，好吧，他是老大。

sentences.zh: 而我会说，不，他不是。

sentences.en: He's a co-equal branch.
sentences.zh: 他是平等的权力分支。

sentences.en: I don't work for the president.
sentences.zh: 我不为总统工作。

sentences.zh: 我为俄克拉荷马州的人民工作。

sentences.en: That's who I work for.
sentences.zh: 那才是我效忠的对象。

sentences.en: And I have a different responsibility to be able to take on.
sentences.zh: 我肩负着不同的责任要去承担。

sentences.en: I think we do have to protect that constitutional integrity of government and how things are set up.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们确实必须维护政府宪法的完整性以及权力的设置方式。

sentences.en: President Trump obviously has influence because there are millions and millions of Americans that also believe in him, many from my state as well, that would say,

sentences.en: that's the opinion that I have, that's the expression that I have.

sentences.zh: 你与前总统

sentences.en: Trump now, briefly?
sentences.zh: 特朗普现在的关系如何，简而言之？

sentences.en: Actually, good still.
sentences.zh: 实际上，依然很好。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: I reached out to him after the assassination attempt and said, hey,
sentences.zh: 在暗杀未遂事件发生后我联系了他，并说：嘿，

sentences.en: Cindy and I are praying for you.
sentences.zh: 辛迪和我在为你祈祷。

sentences.en: You've had a very good response in the statement that he made the very next day on it, on he was obviously protected by God for a reason.
sentences.zh: 他在第二天发表的声明中反响非常好，关于他显然是由于某种原因受到了上帝的庇护。

sentences.en: He needs to live that out.
sentences.zh: 他需要把这一点活出来。

sentences.en: I said, I personally believe that, that that was a semi-miraculous event in a million ways of things that could have gone even worse than they were.
sentences.zh: 我说，我个人相信这一点，那在各种层面上都是一个半奇迹般的事件，事情本可能变得更糟糕。

sentences.en: And so he reached out, he reached right back to be able to say thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以他联系了我，立刻回复表达了感谢。

sentences.en: So we continue to stay engaged in ways where we agree, where we agree, where we disagree, we disagree.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们继续在意见一致的领域保持互动，意见一致就一致，意见不合就保留意见。

sentences.en: And even a statement that he made at lunch about a month and a half ago now when he met with the Republican senators, even in that statement, he said, let's find areas

sentences.zh: 我们可以达成一致的领域，让我们致力于这些领域；至于我们意见不一致的领域，让我们继续讨论。

sentences.en: That's a different attitude than I think a lot of people have about President Trump, that they don't see that part of him, but he is still ultimately a negotiator and he feels like

sentences.en: That is really how he functions on a day-to-day basis.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他日常运作的方式。

sentences.en: Sometimes that works and sometimes it does not.
sentences.zh: 有时这管用，有时不管用。

sentences.en: If you want to project everything that is
sentences.zh: 如果你想把与

sentences.zh: 他解决问题的方式与我不同。

sentences.zh: 我们也没有一起去任何地方出差，所以我真的没有什么机会去深入了解他个人，

sentences.zh: 在我们交谈的同时，

sentences.zh: 我一直在深思迈克·彭斯

sentences.zh: 因为他是一个极其保守、极其虔诚，同时也对特朗普极其忠诚的人，直到他在最后时刻做出了他认为符合原则的立场抉择，

sentences.zh: 结合移民法案以及党内反对你的速度之快，你认为在这个GOP（共和党）里坚持原则还可能吗？

sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.zh: 你把你的原则活出来，在你输掉某次投票或某个你认为重要的议题的那几天，你退一步，然后继续坚持下去。

sentences.zh: 在政治中，大多数事情在你第一次尝试时都不会成功。

sentences.zh: 移民问题是过去35年来多位共和党人可以说尝试过却失败了、尝试过却失败了的一个问题，但它仍然是一个未决问题，
